prompt: Photograph through the rain-covered windscreen of an ambulance at night with a long lens, framed tight on the rear side window of a black saloon passing slowly across, a few feet away. Inside that window, a man in his fifties in a dark suit and loosened tie holds a phone to his ear, frowning, gesturing, absorbed, lit by a small warm reading light. Over the whole image, faintly reflected in the ambulance windscreen: the green trace of a heart monitor and a blue emergency strobe. Water droplets on the glass in sharp focus, raindrops streaking through white headlight glare, sodium-orange bokeh behind. Cold teal shadows, crushed blacks, 85mm, shot on 35mm Kodak Vision3 500T, coarse grain, slightly underexposed, handheld. Vertical 9:16. Thanks.
